103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1094-progress.name: Sputtervalve
1094-progress.text: Hello there! How can I help you?
1094-progress.title: Further Instructions

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5043-progress.name: Mangletooth
5043-progress.text:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
5043-progress.title: Agamaggan's Agility

5044-progress.name: Mangletooth
5044-progress.text:
The shaman and geomancers of the quilboar tribes <snort> call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, $r.

If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you. <snort>
5044-progress.title: Wisdom of Agamaggan

5045-progress.name: Mangletooth
5045-progress.text:
Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>
5045-progress.title: Rising Spirit

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

6128-progress.name: Tonga Runetotem
6128-progress.text: Have you got the reagents I need to make the salve?  The gazelle aren't getting any better on their own, so we better not tarry in our effort to save them!
6128-progress.title: Gathering the Cure

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

883-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
883-progress.text: $N, when you approached I saw a new power in your stride.  Tell me -- has your spirit met with the great Lakota'mani?
883-progress.title: Lakota'mani

884-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
884-progress.text: $N, there is a new power behind your eyes!  You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?
884-progress.title: Owatanka

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

913-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
913-progress.text: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?
913-progress.title: Cry of the Thunderhawk

91899-progress.name: Dokimi
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

95774-complete.name: Mankrik
95774-complete.text:
I will place these adornments with my wife's memorial, so that I never forget her. My blood will always run hot with revenge!

You have done me... done us... a great favor, $N.
95774-complete.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95774-progress.name: Mankrik
95774-progress.text: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
95774-progress.title: Her Name Is Olgra

96875-complete.name: Kamari
96875-complete.text: Your work helps Orgrimmar grow. Know that as you walk the city's paths.
96875-complete.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

98024-complete.name: Thork
98024-complete.text:
What's this? An elf? And you say the Warchief sent you?

<Thork grunts sharply as he looks you up and down.>

You look a little skinny to me, but it matters not. Out here you'll either thrive and survive, or you'll die. That is the way of things in these lands.
98024-complete.title: Journey to the Crossroads

98248-complete.name: Dokimi
98248-complete.text:
You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that.

All we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in!

Do you happen to have the crate this label came with?
98248-complete.title: Shipping Label

98248-progress.name: Dokimi
98248-progress.text: Good day, traveler. How can I assist?
98248-progress.title: Shipping Label
